answer: One concrete defense: anchor each agent to a verified, deduplicated real-world utility meter, proven by signed smart-meter readings. Like a lotus rooted to one pond or a lone cabin on a knoll drawing power up from the valley, each identity binds to a single physical supply point. An operator wanting a thousand agents needs a thousand genuine metered connections, as slow to amass as a glacier; duplicate meter IDs collapse to one admitted voice, so clones buy no extra influence.
